text: そろそろ…　バテて　きたんじゃないか

structure.jp: バテて　きたんじゃないか
structure.en: haven't you started getting worn out?

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb says a change has been building up until now. バテて　きた = 'have started getting worn out'.

patterns.name: 〜のではないか
patterns.explanation: This ending says 'isn't it the case that...?' when the speaker is fairly sure. んじゃ is the spoken short form of のでは. バテて　きたんじゃないか = 'you're getting worn out, aren't you?'
